items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: And I’ve met her son, I recorded a song with Ray Brown Junior

ctx.x: Was there something specific you really liked about Ella Fitzgerald?

Everything. Everything. I mean she was a great musician and a brilliant improviser, and sang with such sincerity. I mean you believed Ella. She sang completely — I mean there was no artifice. I mean there was this natural, beautiful thing that came out of her and was absolutely truthful at all times. But then, getting older and knowing musicians that played with her and learning about who she was as a person, I like her even more. The musicians loved her. She was a great musician. She knew exactly what she was…
I’m going to ask you to move your mic off your sweater a little bit.
